snippet.title: Rakugaki Showtime - PlayStation 1 - Intro and Normal Mode Playthrough & Ending [1080p60]
snippet.description:
Full playthrough / longplay / trueplay of Rakugaki Showtime on the original PS1 or Scribble Showtime which is a more correct translation. An arena fighting game for the PlayStation 1, which see combat revolves around throwing object at one another. Skip to (07:30) if you don't want to watch the animated intro and how to play instructions. Featuring characters from a number of Treasures other games or homage characters when they don't own the copyright. It's great fun and a real shame the game remained a Japanese only release. The original retail version also got recalled following a legal dispute between Enix and Treasure, making the game genuinely rare due to the game being recalled. However that didn't stop plenty of copies being sold and a later PSN release so the legal issues were resolved between the two.

Certain Treasure at their very best and a real shame it never got a western release on any format. Great art gameplay and sound make this a must for any import gamer. As for the difficulty Rakugaki Showtime uses a smart auto adjust system depending on how you play, so the better you do the harder the game gets, however lose two credits in a single fight and the game reduces the difficulty. The harder the fights are the more enemies you have to face in each arena, making for some interesting battle. Damage and health don't change, but having to fight seven enemies on screen at once is rather chaotic. For this video some of the fights were on hard, but credit losses were edited out to keep run time down and so we finished it on normal. As a heads up you need to finish hard a set number of times to unlock some of the characters. On the plus side some over the characters are totally overpowered which makes winning as them much easier. There are also options to show the full health bar of all characters and to show damage dealt to an opponent both of which were set to off for this vido.

Packed full of extra characters and movies to unlock so plenty of replay value in this one. Not a one credit clear, but Randomised Gaming has edited out losses for this run, done on normal, there is an extra credit scene if finished on Hard.

Also known as: ラクガキショータイム (Japanese name)

Release: 1999
Developer: Treasure / 株式会社トレジャー
Publisher: Enix / 株式会社エニックス
Format: Sony PlayStation (PS1) / プレイステーション

Rakugaki Showtime is available on PSN in Japan for PS3 and PSP for more details visit the Japanese store here: https://store.playstation.com/ja-jp/product/JP0082-NPJJ00169_00-0000000000000001 (requires Japanese PSN account to purchase)

Randomised Gaming blog: http://randomisedgaming.tumblr.com  
Twitter: https://twitter.com/rdmdgaming

All footage in this video is captured directly from the PlayStation 2, via an Elgato Game Capture HD60 Pro using an RGB Scart to HDMI upscaler.
